tongue.author: Mohammad2018
tongue.commons_description:
Le diagnostic est généralement posé sur l'aspect clinique sans qu'il soit nécessaire d'effectuer une biopsie de tissu.  Cependant, lorsque les biopsies ont été pratiquées, l'aspect histologique est celui d'un allongement marqué et d'une hyperparakératose des papilles filiformes et de nombreuses bactéries se développant à la surface de l'épithélium. 
La langue poilue peut être confondue avec la leu

expected_tcm.body_colour: hard to judge under dark coating (reported light red in a TCM case)
expected_tcm.pattern: heat or cold-damp accumulation in Stomach/Spleen (grey-black coating = extreme interior heat if dry, extreme cold if moist); stains from coffee/antibiotics must be considered

tongue.note: documented_condition is the Western label from the file page; expected_tcm is the typical TCM reading of that appearance, mapped from the cited references (not a clinical diagnosis).

tongue.author: Chainwit.
tongue.commons_description: This case of a Thai female adult was presented to a public hospital in northern Thailand with complaints of tongue enlargement. The diagnosis of glossitis was made. Further investigation revealed anaemia where iron-deficiency anaemia was later confirmed, with suspicion of hypermenorrhoea as the cause. The patient received oral folic acid and ferrous fumarate and her glossitis slowly improved. For

Wind-Cold (with phlegm) obstructing the channels at the acute stage
Qi and Yin deficiency with Blood stasis (palpitation, 心悸)
Spleen Qi deficiency with Blood deficiency, Yin and Yang deficiency, dampness, phlegm and blood stasis (treated with modified Gui Pi Tang)
Qi and Blood deficiency (deficiency of vital energy and blood)
Yin-Yang imbalance (Yang floating upward), excessive toxic Heat, pathogenic Wind
